meta.title: DoA Threshold Currency (approval.doa.currency) = INR (default)
gaps: Set the tenant-level approval.doa.currency setting to INR.
Use Modular Approval Setup to make approvals attachable to the listed entities.
Observe and verify that the Delegation of Authority matrix uses INR as the currency unit for all spend threshold definitions.
